notes: The scribe is a Panta Brahmin from Kumaon (kūrmmadeśād āgatya) who bathed in the Gaṇḍakī river and copied the text for his livelihood/own stomach (svasyacodārārtham) and to remove obstacles for his daughter's marriage (putryāḥ karagrahaṇakarmaṇi vighnaśāntyai). Year 1702 is expressed both as chronogram (nayana-ambara-sapta-bhū = 1702) and in figures; likely Śaka era 1702 (c. 1780 CE) as catalogued.
